prep: no prep/ directory; plan, audits and comparator selection built by the writer

M01.lineage: cued attempted speech by a locked-in participant (Kennedy neurotrophic-electrode programme)

M02.lineage: stimulus formant trajectories as targets: intended formants assumed equal to the heard stimulus (no own audio, participant is mute)

M03.lineage: per-session Kalman fit on a one-minute mimicry block with F-test unit selection (Wu et al. 2006 / Kim et al. 2008 cursor-BCI lineage)

M04.lineage: attempted speech of a vowel heard just before

M05.lineage: two-channel Neurotrophic Electrode in left precentral gyrus (Kennedy 1989; Bartels et al. 2008)

topics.inclusion_rule: Studies that synthesize speech acoustics from a non-acoustic signal (neural, EMG, articulography, ultrasound, video) online, in real time, with the audio played back to the user while or right after they speak. Boundary: include formant or vocoder synthesis of vowels, words or sentences, and offline studies only when they simulate causal frame-level inference; exclude offline acausal reconstruction, text decoding read out by TTS, and conversion from acoustic input; count versions once.
topics.design_field: ledger M06 design values; published full-text pattern counts (closed-loop audio feedback, offline whole-utterance, causal frame-level)
topics.metric: listener WER %, lower better; latency ms

M07.lineage: no lexicon or language model; continuous formant control

M08.note: two continuously controlled formants (F1, F2) of a 63-parameter Klatt synthesizer; vowels only

topics.inclusion_rule: Include studies that reconstruct speech acoustics (spectrograms, vocoder features or waveforms) from intracranial recordings (ECoG, sEEG or depth electrodes, intracortical arrays) made during overt, mouthed, attempted or imagined speech production. Boundary: exclude reconstruction of heard speech, text-only decoding read out by a TTS engine, and reviews or citation-only mentions; count versions of one study once. The ledger pattern also admits some reviews and text-decoding papers, so its count is an upper bound. Design of interest: how predicted acoustic features become a waveform (neural vocoder such as WaveNet, WaveGlow or HiFi-GAN; Griffin-Lim or other iterative phase reconstruction; parametric vocoder; unit selection).
topics.pattern: reused published topic table; added full-text pattern formant_synthesizer (formant synthesizer|Klatt|decoded formants) in a separate field
topics.design_field: published full-text pattern counts plus formant_synthesizer

M09.lineage: continuous audio output; visual formant cursor in the last 15 of 25 sessions; no confirmation step

M10.lineage: no correction loop beyond continuous steering within a 6 s trial

M11.lineage: canonical vowel formant targets as reference

M12.note: protocol points (no chance level, attractor force, block-order learning confound) go to the claims section; no separate topic
M12.lineage: center-out hit rate and endpoint error, as in cursor BCIs

M13.note: transcutaneous FM telemetry with inductive power, no skin-penetrating connector; authors claim a first

topics.inclusion_rule: Speech or communication studies that record from implanted neural sensors (intracortical, ECoG, sEEG, depth) in humans or animals, classified by how the signal leaves the body: percutaneous connector or pedestal, wireless telemetry (including a transmitter mounted on a percutaneous pedestal), or a fully implanted system with no skin-penetrating hardware. Boundary: reviews and related-work mentions inflate the full-text counts (upper bounds); wearable EMG/EEG wireless devices are outside the population (ledger modality filter).
topics.pattern: ledger modalities in {intracortical_microelectrode, ecog, seeg, intracranial, depth} and a speech or communication term
topics.design_field: full-text regex: percutaneous connector or pedestal; wireless telemetry; fully implanted
topics.metric: online task performance and duration of use
